status: Existing saved-error reaggregation only, no predictions/fits/statistical tests
pairing: Same floor, acquisition direction and exact query position across K; identical query row lists checked
metric: Original scan error averaged within position, original equal-building/floor/direction/K/position hierarchy; p90 is weighted inverse empirical CDF
count_definition: Unweighted counts of paired floor/direction/positions; K5 minus K1 strictly below/above zero means improved/worsened, no pointwise monotonicity requirement
